'''Objectivity''' is a mentality marked by calmness, openness and readiness to learn.

== Objectivity v. Neutrality ==

[[File:Joshua-Johnson-portrait.png|thumbnail|{{#content:Q2428}}]]

According to American journalist and radio host [[Person:Joshua Johnson|Joshua Johnson]], the difference between objectivity and neutrality is like parking a car and abandoning a car. To be objective, one do not have to lack opinion or judgement on a subject, but rather accept their existence and put them aside, and study curiously the phenomenons and the interpretations of others on those phenomenons.<ref>{{#cite:Q2426}}</ref>
